fact: Release of Car 23 in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 d) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, CCTV and video from above the pit stop location, team radio and in-car video evidence. Albon stopped for a tyre change, then had to return to the pits to change tyres again, having reported that the right front wheel was loose. The Stewards observed that the front right wheel gun mechanic made an attempt to tighten the tyre, but then had to try a second time, but by that point the car had left the pits. It was clear from the in-car footage that the tyre was loose, which constitutes releasing in an unsafe condition during a race. The ten second stop-go penalty is mandatory under the regulations. The Stewards intend to investigate after the race whether the driver continued to drive the car, knowing that it was released in an unsafe condition, which is an alleged breach of Art. 34.14.e) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Car Released In An Unsafe Condition
